blockingFindings.title: R4 stream forwarding preservation is not asserted
blockingFindings.rationale: R4 explicitly requires preserving existing stream forwarding. Without this assertion, an implementation could emit markers and summaries while dropping child output and the test would still pass.
blockingFindings.issue: The coverage artifact marks R4 covered, but the R4 test only checks marker count, spawn count, aggregate exit code, and summary text. It does not assert that nested stdout/stderr content from each category is still forwarded to the parent streams.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add assertions in the R4 runner test that the planned child stdout and stderr payloads are present on the corresponding captured parent stdout/stderr streams while the execution marker is also emitted.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R4 explicitly requires preserving existing stream forwarding. Without this assertion, an implementation could emit markers and summaries while dropping child output and the test would still pass.

blockingFindings.title: R7 preservation coverage is materially incomplete
blockingFindings.rationale: R7 is a must requirement with multiple regression-sensitive behaviors. The artifact reports it as covered, but the executable tests leave several required behaviors untested.
blockingFindings.issue: The R7 test covers only pass envelope, report transition, and one outer invocation count. It does not cover the required preserved fail/skipped envelopes, retry behavior, record-and-proceed failed-state display, config-derived timeout behavior, or issue-log side effects.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add spec-local tests or assertions covering the missing R7 preservation points: fail and skipped envelopes, retry behavior, record-and-proceed failed-state display, config-derived timeout behavior, and issue-log side effects.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R7 is a must requirement with multiple regression-sensitive behaviors. The artifact reports it as covered, but the executable tests leave several required behaviors untested.

blockingFindings.title: R8 migration parity has no executable coverage
blockingFindings.rationale: R8 explicitly lists migration parity as required automated coverage. The coverage artifact marks R8 covered, but the actual tests do not cover this dimension.
blockingFindings.issue: R8 requires automated coverage for migration parity, but neither spec-local test file exercises migration behavior or compares old/new artifact handling across migration boundaries.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add a spec-local migration parity test that proves existing final-regression artifacts or migrated state remain compatible with the new bounded child-record evidence format.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R8 explicitly lists migration parity as required automated coverage. The coverage artifact marks R8 covered, but the actual tests do not cover this dimension.

requirements.desc: Every nested test command shall produce one typed execution record containing command argv, started/completed state, exit code, signal, error code, timeout state, spawn error, and bounded stdout/stderr captures.

Child outcomes shall distinguish passed, assertion-failure with concrete assertion output, nonzero-exit without assertion evidence, signal, timeout, spawn-error, and max-buffer outcomes through class-enforced invariants.

Each captured child stream shall record original byte length, captured byte length, truncation state, bounded content, and a durable final-regression attempt-log reference when content exceeds the configured capture bound.

tests/run.js shall emit one machine-readable child execution marker for every executed category while preserving existing stream forwarding, category order, summary, aggregate exit code, and exactly one spawn per category.

The final-regression raw log and final-regression-result.json shall identify each nested command and its typed outcome, and the artifact shall expose bounded child records linked to the raw attempt log.

Final-regression shall set failureNature assertion and current-versus-existing attribution only when preserved evidence supports them; an unsupported attribution shall become unattributed_unknown_failure with no automatic existing-failure eligibility.

The change shall preserve final-regression execution count, pass/fail/skipped envelopes, retry behavior, record-and-proceed failed-state display, status/report transitions, config-derived command/timeout behavior, and issue-log side effects except for evidence-based failure fields.

Automated coverage shall prove all child failure modes, bounded truncation and durable references, raw-log/artifact persistence, evidence-based classification, retained-surface behavior parity, and zero additional test-process invocations without requiring legacy artifact compatibility.
